[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Permutation Cycle** [CF 932C · Permutation Cycle](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/932/C){rating="1600"}

A permutation is a disjoint union of cycles, so "every cycle has length $A$ or $B$" means "tile $N$ positions with blocks of length $A$ and $B$": find $x, y \ge 0$ with $xA + yB = N$. Then rotate each block of consecutive positions by one, which makes it a single cycle of exactly its length.

[Solved in full in @sec-idx-p3-cycle.]{.card-link}

:::
